description: This file implements the ValueLinkApi class which handles encryption, key management, and communication with the ValueLink third-party payment system, including cryptographic operations, key generation, and HTTP request handling.

classes.name: ValueLinkApi
classes.description: Main class providing cryptographic operations, key management, and communication interfaces with ValueLink.

methods.name: encryptPin
methods.description: Encrypts a plain text PIN into a hex string for secure transmission.

methods.name: decryptPin
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted PIN hex string back into the plain text PIN.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a request map to the ValueLink endpoint and returns the response map.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Obtains a singleton instance of ValueLinkApi, optionally reloading keys.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Clears cached keys to force reloading or regeneration.

methods.name: outputKeyCreation
methods.description: Outputs a string with key creation and encryption details for manual database updates.

methods.name: getInitialRequestMap
methods.description: Constructs initial request parameters including merchant info and timestamps.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal as a ValueLink-compatible string amount.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the ISO currency code (currently hardcoded to '840' for USD).

methods.name: getDateString
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted per ValueLink's specification.

methods.name: getWorkingKeyIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the current working key index from cached database values.

methods.name: createKeys
methods.description: Generates a new Diffie-Hellman key pair for secure key exchange.

methods.name: generateKek
methods.description: Creates the Key Encryption Key (KEK) based on Diffie-Hellman shared secret.

methods.name: getValueLinkPublicKey
methods.description: Retrieves the public key from ValueLink for Diffie-Hellman key exchange.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Constructs the private key object from stored database value.

methods.name: generateMwk
methods.description: Creates a new Master Work Key (MWK), an encryption key for data.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses the HTTP response string into a key-value map.
